talk.jaymoskingdoms.teacher.learn: Teach me the way of the %1$s (%2$s).
talk.jaymoskingdoms.teacher.learned: Well learned. The %1$s's craft is yours now, though it will come slower than your first.
message.jaymoskingdoms.class.second: You have learned the %1$s's way. It comes at %2$s%% of your first class. J for the first, Alt and J for this one.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.growth.paths_sub: One path for each class you hold
gui.jaymoskingdoms.growth.feats_help: Each great foe you fell opens a feat. Choose one from the list. It is for keeps, until a Writ of Rebirth.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.growth.paths_help: Choose a class on the left, then the path it will walk. It is for keeps, until a Writ of Rebirth.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feat.owed: A feat is yours to pick (H, Feats and Paths).
message.jaymoskingdoms.path.owed: A class of yours is ready to choose its path (H, Feats and Paths).
message.jaymoskingdoms.path.taken: You walk the path of the %1$s.
feat.jaymoskingdoms.alert.desc: You are never taken by surprise. An ambush does not freeze you for a heartbeat.
feat.jaymoskingdoms.lucky.desc: Three sparks a day, on top of any you earn. Each one turns a failed parry, lockpick or fright into a success.
feat.jaymoskingdoms.mobile.desc: You move faster afoot, and breaking off from a foe costs you no free blow.
feat.jaymoskingdoms.sentinel.desc: Your free blows come twice as often and stop whoever they land on, even one backing away.
feat.jaymoskingdoms.tough.desc: More health now, and a little more for each knowledge level you have.
feat.jaymoskingdoms.healer.desc: Your bandages and rags heal half again as much, and every treatment goes a fifth quicker.
feat.jaymoskingdoms.chef.desc: Kitchen meals you eat give half again as much health and mend you faster.
feat.jaymoskingdoms.shield_master.desc: Your shove comes round twice as fast, wins more often and throws harder. A raised shield softens blasts.
feat.jaymoskingdoms.mage_slayer.desc: A caster within reach of you is struck down mid-spell. You hit casting foes harder and take less from spells.
feat.jaymoskingdoms.skulker.desc: Foes see you from less far in dim light, and less again when you sneak.
feat.jaymoskingdoms.observant.desc: You notice much more without looking, and catch a liar's tell sooner.
feat.jaymoskingdoms.mounted_fighter.desc: Blows from the saddle hit harder, your mount takes less, and horses learn to trust you sooner.
feat.jaymoskingdoms.charger.desc: A blow after a long run hits much harder and throws the foe back.
feat.jaymoskingdoms.linguist.desc: You learn three tongues at once, and every word you learn after counts double.
feat.jaymoskingdoms.actor.desc: A voice that carries: more Presence, better lies, and a sharper eye for other people's.
feat.jaymoskingdoms.inspiring_leader.des: You and your friends near you save better against fear and the rest. After a short rest, they stand taller with absorption.
feat.jaymoskingdoms.crossbow_expert.desc: Your crossbow loads in little more than half the time and its bolts hit harder.
feat.jaymoskingdoms.dungeon_delver.desc: You find traps near you before they find you, and the blow of a trap lands at half strength.
path.jaymoskingdoms.thief.assassin.desc: Blows on a foe who has not noticed you hit much harder.
path.jaymoskingdoms.thief.burglar.desc: Locks open easier, with wider sweet spots and less strain on the pick. You notice more.
path.jaymoskingdoms.thief.swashbuckler.d: Quicker afoot and with the blade, and you break off from a foe without a free blow.
path.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.champion.des: More health, and now and then a blow lands heavy.
path.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.battlemaster: Your orders carry farther, and a blow sometimes trips the foe.
path.jaymoskingdoms.mage.evocation.desc: Your staff and focus spells hit harder.
path.jaymoskingdoms.mage.abjuration.desc: Each cast wards you with absorption, and you take less from spells.
path.jaymoskingdoms.mage.divination.desc: Spells cost less mana and you notice more without looking.
path.jaymoskingdoms.brute.berserker.desc: Below half health, your blows hit much harder.
path.jaymoskingdoms.brute.juggernaut.des: In two or more heavy pieces you take less from every blow and are hard to move.
path.jaymoskingdoms.brute.wrestler.desc: Bare hands hit harder and slow the foe, and your shoves win more often.
path.jaymoskingdoms.marksman.sharpshoote: Shots at far targets hit much harder.
Your crossbow loads faster and close shots hit harder.
path.jaymoskingdoms.marksman.trapper.des: What you shoot is slowed where it stands.
path.jaymoskingdoms.sorcerer.quickened.d: You can imbue again much sooner.
path.jaymoskingdoms.sorcerer.enduring.de: Your imbued blade holds its element far longer.
path.jaymoskingdoms.sorcerer.warded.desc: You take less from magic, blasts and fire.
path.jaymoskingdoms.rider.lancer.desc: Blows from the saddle hit harder.
path.jaymoskingdoms.rider.outrider.desc: Your mount is faster and never hurt by a fall.
path.jaymoskingdoms.rider.horse_archer.d: Shots from the saddle hit harder.
path.jaymoskingdoms.cleric.shepherd.desc: At a short rest you mend the friends around you.
path.jaymoskingdoms.cleric.warden.desc: One more turning a day, and you take less with the holy symbol in hand.
path.jaymoskingdoms.druid.moon.desc: One more shape a day, and each one lasts half again as long.
path.jaymoskingdoms.druid.land.desc: On natural ground, your wounds slowly mend.
path.jaymoskingdoms.monk.open_hand.desc: Bare hands hit harder and shove surer.
path.jaymoskingdoms.monk.shadow.desc: Hard to see in the dim, quick when sneaking, and heavy on the unaware.
path.jaymoskingdoms.paladin.vanguard.des: The first blow on a hale foe hits harder.
path.jaymoskingdoms.paladin.guardian.des: Friends near you take less from every blow and save better.
path.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.hunter.desc: Shots at far targets hit harder.
Your tamed beasts near you are stronger and tougher.
path.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.wayfarer.desc: Quicker afoot, and you land softer.
path.jaymoskingdoms.warlock.blade.desc: Sword blows hit harder and you drink back a share of them.
path.jaymoskingdoms.warlock.chain.desc: Your patron's debts fall due two days later.
path.jaymoskingdoms.tinkerer.alchemist.d: Good draughts you drink last 40% longer.
path.jaymoskingdoms.tinkerer.battle_smit: One more infusion at once, and your blows hit a little harder.
